data.name: Jaswanth
data.gender_notes: Jaswanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaswanth is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Jas’ (wealth) and ‘Wanth’ (treasure). This name signifies being the Lord of Wealth or Treasure. It is also considered an auspicious name for a child as it symbolizes abundance and prosperity. The name Jaswanth carries the meaning “Lord of the Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaswanth usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jaswanth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaswanth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaswanth is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and culture. It is believed to bring blessings of wealth and prosperity. In India, it is customary to name children based on their horoscopes, and Jaswanth is often chosen for a child born under the influence of the affluent Jupiter planet.
data.spiritual_significance: Jaswanth holds spiritual significance as it reminds us of the material and spiritual wealth that comes from within. It signifies the inner treasure of wisdom, peace, and happiness that we all possess. The name encourages us to focus on building inner wealth and spiritual growth, rather than solely on accumulating material possessions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jaswanth: Radiating prosperity and victory, symbolizing the inner warrior triumphing over challenges, embodying the spirit of determination and success.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jaswanth was a powerful king of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 16th century. The name Jaswanth carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jaswanth ruled during a time of great political instability and military conflict.

trends: The name Jaswanth is becoming increasingly popular in India and among the Indian diaspora.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jaswanth remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
